thesis: CROX is a strong, fundamentally backed uptrend holding a three-week post-earnings gap, now pulling back to the entry zone with a defined stop below the 10-day swing low. Revenue growth has accelerated for three quarters while net income is up about 49% YoY, and the stock trades at a low absolute multiple with strong free cash flow. The measured-move target gives good reward/risk from the pullback zone. The main headwinds are the risk-off regime, high leverage, and resistance near 164, so this is a small-size swing long rather than a high-conviction one.
